title: Enterprise Document Archiving System (Financial Sector)
role: Client engagement via Ebtekar Wakhthor LTD · 09/2025 – 04/2026 · DevOps & OpenShift Engineer
problem: A tier-1 banking ecosystem supporting 15M+ active users needed a compliant, repeatable deployment model for an enterprise document archiving platform across DEV, SIT, UAT, and PROD under strict financial regulatory SLAs.
solution: Managed multi-environment Red Hat OpenShift (OKD) infrastructure with fine-grained network isolation, RBAC, and Keycloak SSO. Integrated containerized workloads with IBM FileNet for document management, IBM MQ for transactional messaging, and RabbitMQ for microservice event queuing. Designed GitLab CI/CD pipelines with compliance and vulnerability scanning before every production release.
outcome: Supported heavy enterprise throughput across four regulated environments, processing millions of document ingestions, messaging events, and OCR API extractions daily under audit-ready controls.

snippets.title: OpenShift NetworkPolicy (sanitized)
snippets.code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: filenet-ingress-allow
  namespace: archiving-prod
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: filenet-connector
  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: api-gateway
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 9080
  egress:
    - to:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: ibm-mq
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 1414

role: Client engagement via Ebtekar Wakhthor LTD · 06/2025 – 03/2026 · Lead Cloud & DevOps Engineer
problem: Legacy GIS applications required modernization in a fully air-gapped government environment, including GPU-accelerated capacity and zero-trust ingress/egress controls.
solution: Architected air-gapped Kubernetes environments and GPU-accelerated clusters. Provisioned bare-metal GPU nodes and Kubernetes infrastructure using Python, Terraform, and Ansible. Implemented isolated network boundaries, internal DNS, and zero-trust ingress/egress policies for high-security compliance.
outcome: Provisioned an 8× NVIDIA H100 GPU cluster on bare-metal, reducing spatial query processing latencies by ~40%, while keeping the platform fully air-gapped under zero-trust controls.

snippets.title: Bare-metal GPU node bootstrap (sanitized Ansible)
snippets.code:
- name: Install NVIDIA drivers & container toolkit
  hosts: gpu_nodes
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure GPU driver packages
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - nvidia-driver-550
          - nvidia-container-toolkit
        state: present
        update_cache: true

    - name: Register GPU with container runtime
      ansible.builtin.command: nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=containerd
      notify: Restart containerd

  handlers:
    - name: Restart containerd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: containerd
        state: restarted

title: Production Observability Stack
role: Platform Engineer, Raed IT Services (Part-Time, Remote)
problem: Hybrid Hetzner and GCP infrastructure lacked unified observability — cross-service outages were detected late and root cause was slow to identify.
solution: Deployed Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and Alertmanager alongside GCP Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging for distributed metrics, centralized log aggregation, and actionable alerting across hybrid workloads.
outcome: Improved cross-service outage detection and faster incident identification across hybrid production infrastructure, supporting a sustained 99.9% availability target.

diagram.alt: Production observability stack flow — Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and Alertmanager across hybrid infrastructure

snippets.title: Alertmanager rule (sanitized)
snippets.code:
- alert: HighErrorRate
  expr: |
    sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (service)
      /
    sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (service)
      > 0.05
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "Elevated 5xx rate on {{ $labels.service }}"
